pattern: (Address already in use|bind: Address already in use|EADDRINUSE|failed to bind to (?:\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|0\.0\.0\.0|:::)\s*:\s*\d+)
explanation: A local socket collision occurred because another process is already bound and listening on the target TCP/UDP port.

pattern: (Permission denied|EACCES|Operation not permitted|Access denied for user)
explanation: POSIX file ownership, directory traversal (rx) permissions, or user capability bitmask prevented the action.

pattern: (Out of memory: Kill process|invoked oom-killer|killed process \d+.*total-vm|Memory cgroup out of memory)
explanation: Kernel Out-Of-Memory (OOM) killer terminated the process to protect kernel ring buffers from starvation.

pattern: (No space left on device|ENOSPC|write error: No space left on device)
explanation: Storage volume has exhausted available physical data blocks (0 remaining blocks).

pattern: (No space left on device.*inode|cannot create directory: No space left on device|mkdir: cannot create directory.*No space left on device)
explanation: Filesystem inode table is 100% saturated despite remaining physical disk block capacity.
